descriptions.zh-CN: 阳光透过建筑结构投下明暗对比，几何线条与光影交织。
descriptions.en: Sunlight casts strong contrasts through architectural structures, where geometric lines meet light and shadow.

descriptions.zh-CN: 辽阁的场景与柔和的光线，远方的地平线让人心情沉静。
descriptions.en: A wide scene under soft light; the distant horizon brings a sense of calm.

descriptions.zh-CN: 夜晚拍摄，灯光在建筑与街道之间交织，营造出宁静的光影氛围。
descriptions.en: Shot at night, lights weave through buildings and streets, creating a quiet play of light and shadow.
